back_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
Go and stand at the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message there: O all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD, hear the word of the LORD.
The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says this: Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you dwell in this place.
Do not trust in deceptive words that say, 'This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.'
For if you truly amend your ways and your deeds, if you truly act justly toward one another,
if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow other gods to your own harm,
then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
But behold, you keep trusting in deceptive words that profit you nothing.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods you have not known,
and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My name, and say, 'We are delivered,' only to go on doing all these abominations?
Has this house, which bears My name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I Myself have seen it, declares the LORD.
But go now to My place that was in Shiloh, where I first made My name dwell, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
And now, because you have done all these deeds, declares the LORD, and because I spoke to you again and again but you did not listen, and I called you but you did not answer,
what I did to Shiloh I will do to the house that bears My name, in which you trust, and to the place I gave to you and your fathers.
And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I cast out all your brothers, all the offspring of Ephraim.
As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or petition for them, and do not plead with Me, for I will not listen to you.
Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven, and they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
Is it Me they provoke? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own faces?

Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, My anger and My wrath will be poured out on this place, on man and on beast, on the trees of the field and on the produce of the ground, and it will burn and not be quenched.
The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says this: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
For on the day I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely speak to them and command them concerning burnt offerings and sacrifice.
But this is what I commanded them: Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you will be My people; and walk in all the way that I command you, so that it may go well with you.
But they did not listen or incline their ear; they walked in their own counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and they went backward and not forward.
From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I sent you all My servants the prophets, again and again, day after day.
Yet they did not listen to Me or incline their ear, but stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you; and when you call to them, they will not answer you.
Therefore say to them: This is the nation that did not obey the voice of the LORD their God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished and is cut off from their lips.
Cut off your consecrated hair and throw it away; raise a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.
For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set their detestable idols in the house that bears My name, defiling it.
They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire — which I did not command, nor did it ever come up in My mind.

Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no more room.
The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth, and no one will frighten them away.

And I will make to cease from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, for the land will become a wasteland.
